entry.title: New: Bill 49 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-32, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025

Appropriates revenues in the Federal Grants – 2025 Pathways to Removing Obstacles Housing account ($1,500,000)

Latest action: Council: Bill 49 postponed to the Call of the Chair - 06/04/25; never taken up again.
